sections.title: USB-C power
notes: Power only: nothing on this board uses USB data.

sections.title: Dark detector
notes: The sensor pulls this low in room light and lets it rise in the dark.
The switch point is around 1 to 3 lux, so it comes on gradually at dusk.

sections.title: Warm white LED
notes: The transistor turns on as the detector rises, and 150 ohm sets about 13 mA.
Keep this LED’s light off the sensor, or it can turn itself off and flicker. No check here covers that.
